name: Dr. Elena Villanueva
reason: Medical role with no spiritual teaching of her own (12 Nov 2026 re-check, web search only): she runs Modern Holistic Health, a functional-medicine practice and practitioner-training business whose work and podcast centre on toxin testing, root-cause medicine and health crises; the only contemplative content found is podcast episodes where guests (Stacey Loop, Michael Stone, Gary Kraftsow) discuss breathwork. She leads no meditation, yoga or spiritual practice of her own, so nothing is listable; clinical and medical services are never listed.
